# QR Code generator (C++)

`qrcodegen.cpp` and `qrcodegen.hpp`, unchanged, from
[nayuki/QR-Code-generator](https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator) v1.8.0
(`cpp/`). MIT License (in each file's header), Copyright (c) Project Nayuki.

PlayGuard draws the funding links in About as QR codes with it
(`source/view/qr_view.cpp`).
